latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Prompt Generator Skill Online — Generate Video Prompts Instantly.

- Instantly generate ready-to-use AI video prompts from your text or uploaded files (MP4, MOV, TXT, WebM, up to 200MB).
- Automatic cloud API setup and session management for a seamless start.
- Supports export to 1080p MP4 and other formats, with fast cloud rendering.
- Handles multiple workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Credit system gives 100 free anonymous uses with a 7-day token.
- User-friendly actions for upload, status, export, credits, and session state.
